name: amidophosphoribosyltransferase reaction
description: PRPP to 5-phosphoribosylamine; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: phosphoribosylamine--glycine ligase reaction
description: Formation of phosphoribosylglycinamide.

name: GAR transformylase reaction
description: Folate-dependent formation of phosphoribosyl-N-formylglycinamide.

name: GAR formyltransferase 2 reaction
description: Formate- and ATP-dependent alternative formation of phosphoribosyl-N-formylglycinamide.

name: FGAM synthase reaction
description: Formation of phosphoribosylformylglycinamidine.

name: AIR synthetase reaction
description: Cyclization to phosphoribosylaminoimidazole.

name: AIR carboxylase reaction
description: Direct AIR to CAIR conversion; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: N5-CAIR synthetase reaction
description: ATP-dependent formation of N5-carboxyaminoimidazole ribonucleotide.

name: N5-CAIR mutase reaction
description: Conversion of N5-carboxyaminoimidazole ribonucleotide to CAIR.

name: SAICAR synthetase reaction
description: Formation of succinylaminoimidazolecarboxamide ribotide.

name: SAICAR lyase reaction
description: Formation of AICAR and fumarate.

name: AICAR transformylase reaction
description: Folate-dependent formation of FAICAR.

name: FAICAR synthetase reaction
description: Formate- and ATP-dependent alternative formation of FAICAR.

name: IMP cyclohydrolase reaction
description: FAICAR to IMP ring closure; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: adenylosuccinate synthase reaction
description: Formation of adenylosuccinate from IMP.

name: adenylosuccinate lyase reaction
description: Formation of AMP and fumarate from adenylosuccinate.

name: IMP dehydrogenase reaction
description: NAD-dependent oxidation of IMP to XMP, committing the guanylate branch.

name: GMP synthase reaction
description: Glutamine-dependent amination of XMP to GMP.

name: carbamoyl-phosphate synthase reaction
description: Glutamine-dependent formation of carbamoyl phosphate.

name: aspartate carbamoyltransferase reaction
description: Formation of N-carbamoyl-L-aspartate from carbamoyl phosphate and L-aspartate.

name: dihydroorotase reaction
description: Cyclization to (S)-dihydroorotate; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: fumarate-dependent dihydroorotate dehydrogenase reaction
description: Oxidation of (S)-dihydroorotate to orotate using fumarate.

name: quinone-dependent dihydroorotate dehydrogenase reaction
description: Oxidation of (S)-dihydroorotate to orotate using a quinone.

name: NAD-dependent dihydroorotate dehydrogenase reaction
description: Oxidation of (S)-dihydroorotate to orotate using NAD(+).

name: orotate phosphoribosyltransferase reaction
description: Formation of orotidine 5'-phosphate from orotate and PRPP; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: orotidine 5'-phosphate decarboxylase reaction
description: Formation of UMP from orotidine 5'-phosphate.

name: CTP synthase reaction
description: Glutamine-dependent amination of UTP to CTP.

name: 3-phosphoglycerate dehydrogenase reaction
description: NAD-dependent oxidation of 3-phosphoglycerate to 3-phosphooxypyruvate, the committing step of phosphorylated serine biosynthesis.

name: phosphoserine aminotransferase reaction
description: Glutamate-dependent transamination forming O-phospho-L-serine; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: phosphoserine phosphatase reaction
description: Hydrolysis of O-phospho-L-serine to L-serine.

name: serine hydroxymethyltransferase reaction
description: Folate-dependent interconversion of serine and glycine; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation to form glycine.

name: aspartate kinase reaction
description: ATP-dependent phosphorylation of L-aspartate, the committing step of the aspartate amino acid family.

name: aspartate-semialdehyde dehydrogenase reaction
description: NADPH-dependent reduction of 4-phospho-L-aspartate to the semialdehyde; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: homoserine dehydrogenase reaction (NAD)
description: NAD-dependent reduction of L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde to L-homoserine; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: homoserine dehydrogenase reaction (NADP)
description: NADP-dependent reduction of L-aspartate 4-semialdehyde to L-homoserine; used in reverse relative to the Rhea master equation.

name: homoserine kinase reaction
description: ATP-dependent phosphorylation of L-homoserine to O-phospho-L-homoserine.

name: threonine synthase reaction
description: Conversion of O-phospho-L-homoserine to L-threonine.

name: homoserine O-succinyltransferase reaction
description: Succinyl-CoA-dependent activation of L-homoserine.

name: homoserine O-acetyltransferase reaction
description: Acetyl-CoA-dependent activation of L-homoserine.

name: cystathionine gamma-synthase reaction (O-succinylhomoserine)
description: Cysteine-dependent formation of L,L-cystathionine from O-succinyl-L-homoserine.

name: cystathionine gamma-synthase reaction (O-acetylhomoserine)
description: Cysteine-dependent formation of L,L-cystathionine from O-acetyl-L-homoserine.

name: plant cystathionine gamma-synthase reaction
description: Cysteine-dependent formation of L,L-cystathionine from O-phospho-L-homoserine.

name: cystathionine beta-lyase reaction
description: Cleavage of L,L-cystathionine to L-homocysteine and pyruvate.

name: O-succinylhomoserine sulfhydrylase reaction
description: Direct incorporation of inorganic sulfide into O-succinyl-L-homoserine to give L-homocysteine.

name: O-acetylhomoserine sulfhydrylase reaction
description: Direct incorporation of inorganic sulfide into O-acetyl-L-homoserine to give L-homocysteine.

name: cobalamin-dependent methionine synthase reaction
description: Methyl transfer from 5-methyltetrahydrofolate to L-homocysteine.

name: cobalamin-independent methionine synthase reaction
description: Methyl transfer from 5-methyltetrahydropteroyltriglutamate to L-homocysteine.

name: serine O-acetyltransferase reaction
description: Acetyl-CoA-dependent activation of L-serine to O-acetyl-L-serine.

name: cysteine synthase reaction
description: Incorporation of inorganic sulfide into O-acetyl-L-serine to give L-cysteine.

name: cystathionine beta-synthase reaction
description: Condensation of L-serine with L-homocysteine to give L,L-cystathionine.

name: cystathionine beta-synthase reaction (O-acetyl-L-serine)
description: Condensation of O-acetyl-L-serine with L-homocysteine to give L,L-cystathionine.

name: cystathionine gamma-lyase reaction
description: Cleavage of L,L-cystathionine to L-cysteine and 2-oxobutanoate.

name: xylose isomerase reaction
description: alpha-D-xylose = alpha-D-xylulofuranose.

name: xylulokinase reaction
description: D-xylulose + ATP = D-xylulose 5-phosphate + ADP.

name: L-arabinose isomerase reaction
description: beta-L-arabinopyranose = L-ribulose.

name: L-ribulokinase reaction
description: L-ribulose + ATP = L-ribulose 5-phosphate + ADP.

name: L-ribulose-5-phosphate 4-epimerase reaction
description: L-ribulose 5-phosphate = D-xylulose 5-phosphate.

name: L-fucose isomerase reaction
description: L-fucose = L-fuculose.

name: L-fuculokinase reaction
description: L-fuculose + ATP = L-fuculose 1-phosphate + ADP.

name: L-fuculose-1-phosphate aldolase reaction
description: L-fuculose 1-phosphate = (S)-lactaldehyde + dihydroxyacetone phosphate.

name: L-rhamnose isomerase reaction
description: L-rhamnopyranose = L-rhamnulose.

name: rhamnulokinase reaction
description: L-rhamnulose + ATP = L-rhamnulose 1-phosphate + ADP.

name: rhamnulose-1-phosphate aldolase reaction
description: L-rhamnulose 1-phosphate = (S)-lactaldehyde + dihydroxyacetone phosphate.

name: aldose 1-epimerase reaction on D-galactose
description: alpha-D-galactose = beta-D-galactose; used in reverse for catabolism.

name: galactokinase reaction
description: alpha-D-galactose + ATP = alpha-D-galactose 1-phosphate + ADP.

name: galactose-1-phosphate uridylyltransferase reaction
description: alpha-D-galactose 1-phosphate + UDP-alpha-D-glucose = alpha-D-glucose 1-phosphate + UDP-alpha-D-galactose.

name: UDP-glucose 4-epimerase reaction
description: UDP-alpha-D-glucose = UDP-alpha-D-galactose; used in reverse to regenerate UDP-glucose.

name: N-acetylglucosamine kinase reaction
description: N-acetyl-D-glucosamine + ATP = N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + ADP.

name: N-acetylglucosamine-6-phosphate deacetylase reaction
description: N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + H2O = D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + acetate.

name: glucosamine-6-phosphate deaminase reaction
description: alpha-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate + H2O = beta-D-fructose 6-phosphate + ammonium.

name: N-acetylneuraminate lyase reaction
description: aceneuramate = aldehydo-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine + pyruvate.

name: N-acetylmannosamine kinase reaction
description: aldehydo-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine + ATP = aldehydo-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine 6-phosphate + ADP.

name: N-acetylmannosamine-6-phosphate 2-epimerase reaction
description: N-acetyl-D-glucosamine 6-phosphate = aldehydo-N-acetyl-D-mannosamine 6-phosphate; used in reverse for catabolism.

name: glucuronate isomerase reaction on D-galacturonate
description: aldehydo-D-galacturonate = keto-D-tagaturonate.

name: tagaturonate reductase reaction
description: D-altronate + NAD+ = keto-D-tagaturonate + NADH; used in reverse for catabolism.

name: altronate dehydratase reaction
description: D-altronate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + H2O.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxygluconokinase reaction
description: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + ATP = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phospho-D-gluconate + ADP.

name: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-phosphogluconate aldolase reaction
description: 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-6-phospho-D-gluconate = D-glyceraldehyde 3-phosphate + pyruvate.

name: glucuronate isomerase reaction on D-glucuronate
description: D-glucuronate = D-fructuronate.

name: fructuronate reductase reaction
description: D-mannonate + NAD+ = keto-D-fructuronate + NADH; used in reverse for catabolism.

name: mannonate dehydratase reaction
description: D-mannonate = 2-dehydro-3-deoxy-D-gluconate + H2O.

name: ABC-type D-xylose import reaction
description: D-xylose(out) + ATP + H2O = D-xylose(in) + ADP + phosphate + H(+).

name: ABC-type L-arabinose import reaction
description: L-arabinose(out) + ATP + H2O = L-arabinose(in) + ADP + phosphate + H(+).

name: alpha-L-arabinofuranosidase reaction
description: Hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing alpha-L-arabinofuranosyl residues from arabinoxylan.

name: endo-1,4-beta-xylanase reaction
description: Endohydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-xylosidic linkages in xylan.

name: xylan 1,4-beta-xylosidase reaction
description: Hydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-xylans to remove successive D-xylose residues from the non-reducing end.

name: alpha-amylase reaction
description: Endohydrolysis of (1->4)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in starch.

name: pullulanase reaction
description: Hydrolysis of (1->6)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in pullulan and amylopectin.

name: alpha-glucosidase reaction
description: Hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing (1->4)-linked alpha-D-glucose residues, releasing alpha-D-glucose.

name: acetylxylan esterase reaction
description: Hydrolysis of acetyl groups from the xylan backbone, exposing it to endo-acting xylanases.

name: microbial collagenase reaction
description: Digestion of native collagen in the triple-helical region at Gly bonds. Rhea covers collagen hydroxylation, glycosylation and crosslinking but contains no proteolytic cleavage of the helix, so this reaction carries no master and is identified by its EC cross-reference.
